meta.target: hit = views >= 2.0x the channel's median of its 24 nearest uploads (same format)
meta.rounding_note: Public flat metadata: view counts and upload dates are rounded by YouTube (e.g. 75K views; 'about 2 years ago'), Shorts carry no upload date, so Shorts are compared with neighbouring uploads in the same channel feed.
